links.outcome: Accuracy, sensitivity, specificity of RECTIFIER versus study staff screening against expert clinician gold standard
links.effect: Eligibility sensitivity/specificity 92.3%/93.9% for RECTIFIER vs 90.1%/83.6% for study staff; symptomatic heart failure accuracy 97.9% vs 91.7%, MCC 0.924 vs 0.721.
links.quote: RECTIFIER performed better than study staff to determine the inclusion criteria of “symptomatic heart failure” with an accuracy of 97.9% vs 91.7% and an MCC of 0.924 vs 0.721, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented GPT-4 for clinical trial eligibility screening from clinical notes

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of a custom RAG-enabled GPT-4 system (RECTIFIER) for clinical trial screening against manual chart review by study staff on retrospective EHR data, without testing an implementation safeguard or deployment practice comparative condition.
